<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\LoginRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\RegisterRequest;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;

class AuthController extends Controller
{
    public function register(RegisterRequest $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $user = User::create([
            'name' => $request->name,
            'email' => $request->email,
            'password' => Hash::make($request->password),
        ]);

        $token = $user->createToken('api-token')->plainTextToken;

        return response()->json([
            'user' => $user,
            'token' => $token,
        ], 201);
    }

    public function login(LoginRequest $request): JsonResponse
    {
        if (!Auth::attempt($request->only('email', 'password'))) {
            return response()->json([
                'message' => 'Invalid credentials.',
            ], 401);
        }

        $token = Auth::user()->createToken('api-token')->plainTextToken;

        return response()->json([
            'user' => Auth::user(),
            'token' => $token,
        ]);
    }

    public function logout(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $request->user()->currentAccessToken()->delete();

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Logged out successfully.',
        ]);
    }

    public function user(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        return response()->json($request->user());
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\StoreNoteRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateNoteRequest;
use App\Models\Note;
use App\Http\Resources\NoteResource;
use App\Services\NoteService;
use App\DTO\NoteDTO;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;

class NoteController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly NoteService $service
    ) {}

    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        Gate::authorize('viewAny', Note::class);

        $notes = $this->service->getAll($request->query());
        return NoteResource::collection($notes);
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created resource in storage.
     */
    public function store(StoreNoteRequest $request)
    {
        Gate::authorize('create', Note::class);

        $dto = NoteDTO::fromRequest($request);
        $note = $this->service->create($dto);
        return new NoteResource($note);
    }

    /**
     * Display the specified resource.
     */
    public function show(Note $note)
    {
        Gate::authorize('view', $note);

        return new NoteResource($note);
    }

    /**
     * Update the specified resource in storage.
     */
    public function update(UpdateNoteRequest $request, Note $note)
    {
        Gate::authorize('update', $note);

        $dto = NoteDTO::fromRequest($request);
        return new NoteResource($this->service->update($note, $dto));
    }

    /**
     * Remove the specified resource from storage.
     */
    public function destroy(Note $note)
    {
        Gate::authorize('delete', $note);

        $this->service->delete($note);
        return response()->noContent();
    }

}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Note;
use App\DTO\NoteDTO;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;

class NoteService
{
    public function getAll(array $filters = []): Collection
    {
        $query = Note::query();

        foreach ($filters as $field => $value) {
            if (in_array($field, (new Note())->getFillable(), true)) {
                $query->where($field, $value);
            }
        }

        return $query->get();
    }

    public function create(NoteDTO $dto): Note
    {
        return Note::create($dto->toArray());
    }

    public function find(int|string $id): Note
    {
        return Note::findOrFail($id);
    }

    public function update(Note $note, NoteDTO $dto): Note
    {
        $note->update($dto->toArray());
        return $note->fresh();
    }

    public function delete(Note $note): bool
    {
        return $note->delete();
    }

}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\DTO;

use App\Http\Requests\StoreNoteRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateNoteRequest;

readonly class NoteDTO
{
    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>|null  $provided
     */
    public function __construct(
        public ?string $body = null,
        private ?array $provided = null
    ) {}

    public static function fromRequest(StoreNoteRequest|UpdateNoteRequest $request): self
    {
        $data = $request->validated();

        return new self(
            body: $data['body'] ?? null,
            provided: array_keys($data)
        );
    }

    /**
     * The fields the request sent, or every property when built by hand.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        $values = get_object_vars($this);
        unset($values['provided']);

        return $this->provided === null ? $values : array_intersect_key($values, array_flip($this->provided));
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Note;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class NoteControllerTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_can_list_notes(): void
    {
        Note::factory()->count(3)->create();

        $response = $this->getJson('/api/notes');

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonCount(3, 'data');
    }

    public function test_can_create_note(): void
    {
        $data = [
            'body' => 'Test text content',
        ];

        $response = $this->postJson('/api/notes', $data);

        $response->assertStatus(201);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('notes', [
                    'body' => 'Test text content',
                ]);
    }

    public function test_can_show_note(): void
    {
        $note = Note::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->getJson("/api/notes/{$note->getKey()}");

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonFragment(['id' => $note->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_can_update_note(): void
    {
        $note = Note::factory()->create();
        $data = [
            'body' => 'Test text content',
        ];

        $response = $this->putJson("/api/notes/{$note->getKey()}", $data);

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('notes', [
                    'body' => 'Test text content',
                ]);
    }

    public function test_can_delete_note(): void
    {
        $note = Note::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->deleteJson("/api/notes/{$note->getKey()}");

        $response->assertStatus(204);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('notes', ['id' => $note->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_create_note_validates_required_fields(): void
    {
        $response = $this->postJson('/api/notes', []);

        $response->assertStatus(422);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Models\Note;
use App\Services\NoteService;
use App\DTO\NoteDTO;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class NoteServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private NoteService $service;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->service = new NoteService();
    }

    public function test_can_get_all_notes(): void
    {
        Note::factory()->count(5)->create();

        $result = $this->service->getAll();

        $this->assertCount(5, $result);
    }

    public function test_can_filter_notes(): void
    {
        Note::factory()->count(3)->create();

        $result = $this->service->getAll([]);

        $this->assertCount(3, $result);
    }

    public function test_can_create_note(): void
    {
        $dto = new NoteDTO(
            body: 'Test text',
        );

        $note = $this->service->create($dto);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Note::class, $note);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('notes', 1);
    }

    public function test_can_find_note(): void
    {
        $note = Note::factory()->create();

        $found = $this->service->find($note->getKey());

        $this->assertEquals($note->getKey(), $found->getKey());
    }

    public function test_can_update_note(): void
    {
        $note = Note::factory()->create();
        $dto = new NoteDTO(
            body: 'Test text',
        );

        $updated = $this->service->update($note, $dto);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Note::class, $updated);
    }

    public function test_can_delete_note(): void
    {
        $note = Note::factory()->create();

        $result = $this->service->delete($note);

        $this->assertTrue($result);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('notes', 0);
    }
}
